mapper.sql: select r.version, r.return_id, r.return_no, r.purchase_order_id, r.purchase_order_no, r.return_title, r.supplier_name, r.total_amount, coalesce(detail_summary.total_quantity, 0) as total_quantity, coalesce(detail_summary.returned_quantity, 0) as returned_quantity, coalesce(detail_summary.remaining_quantity, 0) as remaining_quantity, r.return_date, r.status, r.return_reason, r.responsibility, r.attachment_urls, r.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, r.applicant_id, r.applicant_name, u.nick_name as applicant_nick_name, r.applicant_dept_id, applicant_dept.dept_name as applicant_dept_name, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from inv_purchase_return r left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = r.shop_dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.applicant_id left join sys_dept applicant_dept on applicant_dept.dept_id = r.applicant_dept_id left join ( select version, return_id, sum(coalesce(quantity, 0)) as total_quantity, sum(coalesce(returned_quantity, 0)) as returned_quantity, sum(coalesce(quantity, 0) - coalesce(returned_quantity, 0)) as remaining_quantity from inv_purchase_return_detail group by return_id ) detail_summary on detail_summary.return_id = r.return_id
mapper.insert: insert into inv_purchase_return ( return_no, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_no, return_title, supplier_name, total_amount, return_date, status, return_reason, responsibility, attachment_urls, shop_dept_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{returnNo}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{purchaseOrderNo}, #{returnTitle}, #{supplierName}, #{totalAmount}, #{returnDate}, #{status}, #{returnReason}, #{responsibility}, #{attachmentUrls}, #{shopDeptId}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicantDeptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.select: select version, return_id, return_no, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_no, return_title, supplier_name, total_amount, return_date, status, return_reason, responsibility, attachment_urls, shop_dept_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from inv_purchase_return where return_id = #{returnId} for update
